# Dorothy & Roy Gardner

- [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md) — Sibling of — [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md) — brother · since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Gardners’Call P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024), [v3 ch.Weddings P2](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0002)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives news that a publisher has accepted one of her story sketches, which she happily celebrates with her housemates at Patty's Place. During a walking party with [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md), she learns that his family intends to visit her. The Gardner family arrives a day earlier than expected on Friday, leading to a frantic scramble and an awkward yet memorable call.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXVI The Gardners’Call
